description: Recurring UK open mic nights in a city, with day/frequency, signup method, backline and fee. Use `day` for "open mic tonight / on Thursday" (UK time). Filter by performer type (music, comedy, poetry...) and by kit the night lists (has_pa, has_backline, has_engineer - as the listing states it; a night that does not say is counted in a note, not treated as "none"). Paginated.

day.description: Optional: "today"/"tonight", "tomorrow", or a weekday (mon..sun). Resolved in UK time.

has_backline.description: Only nights that list drums or amps (or full backline) provided.

has_engineer.description: Only nights that list a sound engineer.

has_pa.description: Only nights that list a PA (or full backline) provided.

offset.description: Row offset for paging (use next_offset from a prior call).

performer_type.description: Optional: e.g. "music", "comedy", "poetry" - matches the listing's performer types.

name: search_open_mics
title: Search open mic nights
